answer: Each agent must generate a unique quartz-bound beacon by solving one sequential puzzle from a shared zenith orchard of 256 emission-seeded challenges that advances only after the prior layer seals. An island-scale farm of 200 clones must queue on that single advancing layer%3B the 200th pays ~200 × 75s wall-clock plus 1.6e10 cumulative hashes%2C while one honest agent finishes its layer in 75s for ~6e7 hashes. The beacon embeds the prior root for checking. Failure mode%3A if layer seals outpace challenge difficulty a low-latency attacker can still batch the queue.
